BSI documents were downloaded from Internet Archive raw snapshots of the exact URLs in source_url (https://web.archive.org/web/<ts>id_/<url>): AR2025-ID 20260425171218; AR2024 (www.bankbsi.co.id/storage/reports/H32Xdj...pdf) 20260331233437 - the ir.bankbsi.co.id/misc/AR/AR2024-ID.pdf snapshot (20260123105522) is truncated at 5 MiB; AR2023-ID 20260525124655; AR2022-ID 20230601163621; AR2021-IDN 20230601162312; FY2021 Company Update deck 20220204124231; Q1 2026 published statement 20260711074257; AGMS 2026 summary 20260711083344; AGMS 2022 summary 20220620165336; rights-issue supplementary disclosure 20230204205824. The English AR2025 (www.bankbsi.co.id/storage/reports/8kf42X...pdf, 20261017171539) was used only to read/translate. KSEI dividend notices were fetched directly from web.ksei.co.id.

FY2019-FY2020 BASIS (decision): BSI is the legal continuation of PT Bank BRIsyariah Tbk (ticker BRIS), which absorbed Bank Syariah Mandiri and BNI Syariah on 1 Feb 2021. The merger was a common-control combination accounted for by pooling of interests (PSAK 38); the audited FY2021 FS (AR2021 PDF pp. 558-562, Note 53 pp. 712-714) present the 31 Dec 2020 and 1 Jan 2020 comparatives RESTATED as if the three banks had always been combined, and AR2021/AR2022 highlight tables print the same restated 2020 (and 2019) figures and ratios. Those restated figures are stored for FY2019 and FY2020 because they are what the audited statements present as the comparative and they are comparable with FY2021+. Legal-entity BRIsyariah alone (Note 53): 31 Dec 2020 total assets 57,715.586, equity 5,444.288, FY2020 net income 248.054; 31 Dec 2019 total assets 43,123.488, equity 5,088.036. FY2020 cash-coverage, FaR and CASA come from BSI's FY2021 deck (pro forma merged). Growth FY2020->FY2021 is organic (same perimeter); growth FY2019->FY2020 is also on the merged perimeter.

FY2020 PER-SHARE: EPS 53.52 is the restated pooling EPS (weighted 40,877,546,276 shares, i.e. the 31,130,700,245 merger shares deemed outstanding from 1 Jan 2020). fy.2020.shares_out is null: the only FY-end count printed (9,900,508,698, legal BRIsyariah) is on a different basis from the restated equity/EPS, and storing it would give a meaningless FY2020 BVPS (~Rp2,196 vs ~Rp608 in FY2021). fy.2020.year_end_price (2,250) is the real BRIS close (legal entity); the market already priced the agreed merger (EGMS 15 Dec 2020).

ENTITY / BASIS: BSI has no subsidiaries, associates or SPVs (AR2025 PDF pp. 145-146), so its stand-alone audited statements are the full reporting entity; money figures are stored with basis 'consolidated' and equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Ratios are BSI's own OJK individual-basis ratios (basis 'bank_only'). label_overrides map the sharia terms.

DEFINITIONS: loans_gross = BSI's reported total financing (principal of murabahah/istishna/ijarah receivables + qardh + mudharabah + musyarakah + net assets acquired for ijarah, before allowance) from the MD&A collectibility/target tables; FY2025 ties exactly to the audited FS lines. deposits = BSI's reported third-party funds (DPK, OJK basis), which runs ~0.7-1.0tn below the sum of the two audited FS lines (wadiah deposits + mudharabah deposits); the FS sums are given in each note. nim = NI (Net Imbalan). FaR (Financing at Risk) is stored as lar. 'Cash Coverage' is stored as npl_coverage. CoC is called 'Cost of Financing (CoC)' in AR2022 and 'Cost of credit' in AR2024.

RATIO SOURCES: FY2023-FY2025 from the AR2025 ratio table, FY2022 from AR2024, FY2021 from AR2023, FY2020 from AR2022 (restated column) - always the latest AR that prints the year; values were cross-checked against each year's own AR with no differences. CoC/FaR/coverage/CASA are not in any ratio table and come from BoC/BoD reports, KPI tables and the FY2021 deck (see each loc). Analyst decks after FY2021 are listed on the IR site but were never archived, hence the nulls for FY2023 CoC, FY2024-FY2025 coverage and FY2025 CoC/FaR.

CONFLICTS / DOUBTS: (1) FY2022 cash coverage: AR2022 BoC report says 183.12%, AR2023 says 189.56% for 2022 (stored). (2) FY2024 FaR: the KPI table prints target 8.63% and realisation 7.25% (stored 7.25). (3) FY2020 NIM: AR 6.04% vs deck 6.05%; the deck's CER (52.69/52.23) differs from the AR CIR (53.74/52.57, stored). (4) FY2023 CASA 60.57% comes from a BoC monitoring table (Dec'23), not a ratio table. (5) FY2020 deposits are printed in Rp billion (209,906) without decimals. (6) Dividend announcement dates differ between ARs (FY2021: 27 vs 31 May 2022; FY2022: 22 vs 24 May 2023); as_of_date uses the AGMS date.

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend per year out of FY2021-FY2025 profit (payout 25%, 10%, 15%, 15%, 20%); no interim or special dividends. No dividend out of FY2020 profit (AGMS 6 May 2021, AR2021 PDF p. 343; the IR dividend page also shows FY2020 and FY2019 as N/A), so fy.2020.payout_ratio = 0 and there is no FY2020 record. DPS and dates from KSEI notices (FY2021-FY2024) and the AGMS 2026 summary (FY2025); totals from the ARs/AGMS summaries and the IR dividend page (snapshot 20260123110817). All totals reconcile with DPS x shares and profit x payout within 0.01%.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: one rights issue (PMHMETD I, ex-date 14 Dec 2022, 90,000:10,941 at Rp1,000; 4,999,952,795 new shares). No splits, reverse splits or bonus issues ever (AR2025 PDF p. 147 share-issuance chronology; AGMS 2026 agenda has none). Not recorded as corporate actions because the schema has no type for them: the 1 Feb 2021 merger issuance of 31,130,700,245 shares to BSM/BNIS shareholders (9,900,508,698 -> 41,031,208,943) and MESOP exercises (184,395,200 shares in 2020; 98,098,400 in 2021). Neither is a split, so there is no per-share adjustment.

NAME / CONTROL: after the EGMS of 22 Dec 2025 amended the articles (Series A Dwiwarna special rights under the new SOE law), Kemenkum approval AHU-0003351.AH.01.02.TAHUN 2026 of 23 Jan 2026 made the bank a Persero: legal name 'PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (Persero) Tbk' (AR2025 PDF p. 234). Since 27 Jan 2026 control passed from PT Bank Mandiri (51.47%) to PT Danantara Asset Management (special power of attorney from BP BUMN). Shareholders at 31 Dec 2025: Mandiri 51.47%, BNI 23.24%, BRI 15.38%, public 9.90%.
